claims: Team USA defeated the Dominican Republic 2-1 on March 15, 2026.
Team USA advanced to the 2026 World Baseball Classic final.
Team USA's advancement marks their third consecutive appearance in the World Baseball Classic championship game.
Team USA will face the winner of the Italy-Venezuela semifinal on Tuesday, March 17, 2026 at 8 PM ET in Miami.
Gunnar Henderson hit a solo homer in the fourth inning.
Roman Anthony hit a solo homer in the fourth inning.
Starter Paul Skenes allowed one run over 4.1 innings.
Mason Miller closed the game with a controversial strikeout of Geraldo Perdomo.
Julio Rodríguez robbed a home run from Aaron Judge.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final date is Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final time is 8:00 PM ET.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final location is LoanDepot Park, Miami.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final teams are Team USA vs. winner of Venezuela/Italy.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final broadcast is FOX.
Team USA lost the 2023 final to Japan.
